messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Plot Map by adding Segregated Distorted markers with different colour
parts:
There's no immediate way to do this, but you might look at the code to plot.map and seek to modify it for your purposes.

https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/R/plot.R#L252

The function uses segments() to make the ticks at the markers. You want to add a 'col' argument to that, to use different colors for the markers with segregation distortion.

https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/R/plot.R#L381
https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/R/plot.R#L420

karl
